deep_analysis:
PORTFOLIO: 2 open (1 long, 1 short), +0.03 unrealized, 2/6 slots used. 24h closed: 24 trades, 5W, -0.24 USDT. The bleed is not big individual disasters — it is many small ATR-SL and trail-arm-timeout exits (1W/49 atr_sl_hit over 7d) failing to offset the trail winners that do print (HYPE +11.9%, ZRO +16.4%).

BTC SHORT #16320 (ai-trader-pending, 4h open, -0.12%): WRONG SIDE of the regime. BTC 15m and 4h are both LONG_BIAS, trend_quality STRONG_UP, linreg LEAN_BULL, and BTC has pinned AT EMA300 for ~10 hours while grinding 82760-82860. Our SL sits at 82965 — only 0.18% above the current 82819 price and just 0.12% above this hour's high of 82860. One ordinary 5m candle tags it. The last BTC SHORT (16317) died the identical way: entry 82804, stopped at 83156, -2.13%. The winning side of both shorts was LONG. If BTC pushes through 82860 into the EMA300 resolve, this is a coin-flip short with a hair trigger inside a chop pin — the exact chop profile (atr_sl_hit family) that went 1W/49 over 7d. Would I open this fresh? No.

DOGE LONG #16321 (bb-bounce-v2-long+, 1h, +0.31%): thesis not broken but weak. meta_rsi 50.0 sits in the LONG 45-55 band — the single worst band in the book (7d: 33T, 8W, -1.92). DOGE 15m regime is NEUTRAL (conf 52.6), volume on the last hour of 5m candles is fading (5.0M -> ~180-850k), and the signal itself (bb-bounce-v2-long+) is a 7d loser: 15T, 6W, -0.64. It needs +0.40% to arm the trail and has so far printed +0.31% at best with TP 1.5% away. Correct playbook: give it a defined runway — if it has not armed the trail by ~08:30 UTC, exit flat rather than let trail_arm_timeout take it (7d: 11T, 2W, -0.48).

Portfolio direction is nominally balanced (1L/1S) but the short is the exposed leg. Correlation: a BTC move through 82860-83000 stops the short AND lifts every long together — one event, two stops. No trade is up 2% (no BE stop due), none up 5% (no trail due), none open 8h+ (BTC shortest at 4h).

Opportunity cost: 4 slots free while the 15m tape shows 65 coins LONG_BIAS vs 6 SHORT_BIAS. We are short in a long-bias market with half the book unused.

pattern_alerts:
All figures verified by direct PostgreSQL queries on 2026-10-21 (7d and 24h windows; meta_rsi = _signal_metadata->>'rsi_14', never entry_rsi_14).

PATTERN 1 — WRONG-SIDE SHORTS (n=13 pump-chain- SHORT 7d, plus 4/4 short losses in 24h). pump-chain- 7d: 13T, 1W, -0.58 — worst signal in the book (lifetime 41T, 19.5% WR, -0.88). Every short loss in the last 24h closed with exit price ABOVE entry: CRV 0.3895->0.3913, COMP 25.657->25.95 (-5.71%), COMP 22.804->23.151 (-7.61%), BTC 82804->83156 (-2.13%). THE WINNING SIDE WAS LONG — price rose against us every time while the 15m tape ran 65 LONG_BIAS vs 6 SHORT_BIAS. We were not on it because pump-chain- keeps firing shorts on coins whose own 15m regime is up.

PATTERN 2 — CHOP ENTRIES NEVER ARM THE TRAIL (n=153 exits, 7d). Losing exits: atr_sl_hit 49T 1W -3.69, hard_max_loss 20T 0W -2.27, trail_arm_timeout 11T 2W -0.48, hard_sl 7T 0W -0.53 — combined 87T, 3W, -6.97. Winning exits: profit-monster-trail 29T 27W +1.66, atr_trail_hit 13T 11W +1.83, trail_sl 2T 2W +0.67, rr_engine_trail_hit 3T 3W +0.20, UNIVERSAL_MAX_HOLD 4T 4W +0.26, atr_tp_hit 3T 3W +0.15 — combined 54T 51W +4.34. Every dollar of 7d profit comes from trades that reached the trail. The WINNING side of the losers was simply "no follow-through" — coin chopped, never hit +0.40%, and the SL or timeout collected. Entry without momentum = the loss.

PATTERN 3 — MID-BAND RSI ENTRIES ARE THE CHOP ZONE (n=126 with meta_rsi, 7d). LONG: <45 15T -0.36 | 45-55 33T 8W -1.92 (worst) | 55-65 25T -0.51 | 65+ 15T 8W +1.19 (BEST). SHORT: <45 11T -0.25 | 45-55 18T 3W -0.85 (worst) | 55-65 8T +0.35 | 65+ 4T +0.16. The WINNING side in both directions is the strong-momentum band, not the timid middle: long strength, short weakness. Mid-band entries (RSI ~45-55) are where we bleed — DOGE LONG currently open at meta_rsi 50.0 sits exactly there.

PATTERN 4 — SINGLE-COIN LOSER CLUSTER: COMP took 3 losses in 24h (-0.13, -0.17, -0.01) across SHORT, SHORT, LONG — we traded COMP in all three directions within 24 hours and lost all three. That is chop whipsaw, not edge; COMP should be skipped until it trends.

PATTERN 5 — LEVERAGE OUTLIER: BTC LONG ai-trader-manual at 40x lost -21.37% (cut_loser) on 2026-10-20. Manual oversize remains the single largest PnL hole in the window. Not signal quality — position sizing.
